author: GavinNewsom
text:
What we saw from the White House yesterday was bullshit.

It’s like Big Pharma saying we don’t need the FDA.

Donald Trump’s “let it rip” approach to AI is RECKLESS.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California is protecting reproductive freedom and EXPANDING access to care.

More access to medication abortion. Stronger care for veterans. More protections for patients.

In California, your fundamental freedoms are NOT up for debate.

author: GavinNewsom
text: The Golden Age of “Super Intelligence.”

author: GavinNewsom
text: Your tax payer dollars at work!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump and RFK Jr. can talk all they want about “Making America Healthy Again” while they GUT the agencies responsible for keeping our food safe and recalls pile up.

California isn’t waiting around for Washington.

We just passed a first-in-the-nation law creating a new seal so families can easily spot foods that aren’t ultra-processed.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices are at near-record highs and Trump’s response is to force you to get fewer miles out of every tank of gas.

Make America Smoggy Again.

Sponsored by Big Oil.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
69 years ago today, 9 brave African American kids walked into Little Rock Central High School testing the limits of desegregation in the South.

I had the honor of visiting Central when I was in Arkansas and I was reminded that this isn’t ancient history—it is within living memory.

There are people who want to “go back” to a world most wouldn’t even recognize. 

We cannot take these advances for granted. We must continue to fight for equality every single day.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Another MAGA election rigging attempt DENIED.

They will keep trying until we vote them out.

Let’s take it all back this November. VOTE.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
MAGA sheriffs CANNOT seize ballots in California. Period.

The California Supreme Court just affirmed that democracy is alive and well in our state. And, the new laws I just signed last week provide additional protections so politicians can't attempt to take your vote away.

Voting in California is safe and secure and we're going to keep it that way.

author: GavinNewsom
text: A win for democracy and the Constitution.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The FOURTH largest economy in the world now runs on two-thirds clean energy.

California proved the skeptics WRONG.

You don’t have to choose between climate action and economic growth. We’re doing both.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is doubling down on oil as the climate crisis gets WORSE.

California is doing the opposite — breaking our dependence on fossil fuels while growing the FOURTH largest economy in the world.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is sabotaging America’s climate progress and doing the bidding of big polluters.

California is standing on the world stage — STOPPING him.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Trump’s insane war and tariffs are making it easier for Democrats to win — but we need to fight. 

VOTE THIS NOVEMBER!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
World leaders keep asking me: What the hell is going on in America?

I’m telling them Trump is trying to tear down our democracy — but the American people WON’T let him!

author: GavinNewsom
text: Don’t worry, America — our day trader in chief is hard at work.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Nearly 7 months into Donald Trump’s reckless war, and there’s STILL no plan or no end in sight.

Meanwhile, Americans are stuck with HIGHER costs and gas prices.

What exactly are Americans paying for?

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Climate action and affordability MUST go hand in hand.

California is proving they can — cutting pollution, lowering energy bills and investing billions back into our communities.

We can protect the planet AND lower costs.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Americans are paying MORE for groceries. MORE for electricity. MORE for healthcare. MORE because of tariffs.

THIS is the Golden Age?

author: GavinNewsom
text:
More than 9 out of 10 days this year, California has run on 100% CLEAN ENERGY for at least part of the day.

All while powering the FOURTH largest economy in the world.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The President of the United States of America blocked access to the free press and launched state-run media.

This is authoritarianism in action. 

We can end his unchecked power when we take back Congress this November. VOTE.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California just enacted the STRONGEST data center protections in the nation.

We’re protecting Californians from higher costs and giving communities more control over their electricity, water, and land.

While Donald Trump pushes deregulation and lets industry reap massive profits at the expense of working people, we’re making sure Californians remain in the driver’s seat.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is a failure. Instead of regulating AI, he’s posting polls to rename it.

California is taking action. I just signed an executive order accelerating America’s first independent AI safety oversight framework. 

More to come!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
I just signed new laws protecting your ballot and STOPPING Trump’s attacks on vote-by-mail — making it a felony to seize ballots or interfere with our elections.

Trump can try all he wants. California WILL protect your right to vote!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
For the last year, Donald Trump has treated the National Guard as his political weapon — deploying troops into American cities and trampling over states’ rights.

California has seen enough.

I just signed a bill PROHIBITING other state militaries from entering California unless they have explicit permission from the Governor.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Seizing ballots.

Taking stakes in private companies.

Deploying troops into American cities.

Banning news from the White House.

The stakes could not be clearer. This November, VOTE.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Democracy is LITERALLY on the line this November. 

Vote.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
BREAKING: I just signed an EXECUTIVE ORDER to dramatically accelerate independent oversight of AI companies and advance the creation of an “AI kill switch.”

With Donald Trump and Congress failing to lead, California is stepping up to keep all Americans safe.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices SKYROCKETED in Illinois overnight by 16¢.

Please stop the winning, @realDonaldTrump — it’s too much sir!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices SKYROCKETED in Ohio overnight by 17¢.

Make the winning stop, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices SKYROCKETED in Indiana overnight by 17¢.

Amazing stuff, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices SKYROCKETED in Michigan overnight by 21¢.

Great work, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices SKYROCKETED in Wisconsin overnight by 23¢.

Incredible work, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas prices SKYROCKETED in Iowa overnight by 25¢.

Thanks, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text: The average American family is spending an ADDITIONAL $4,200 every year because of Donald Trump.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Trump's closing message: 

Iran First, your gas bill second.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
This is SICK! 

Donald Trump is threatening to hold disaster relief hostage based on how people vote.

This UN-AMERICAN PRESIDENCY ENDS on November 3rd.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Wow, the Golden Age is amazing, sir!!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Oh they are SCARED.

They know they are going to lose the midterms and we hold the power. 

VOTE this November!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Chris Wright’s COMPLETE FAILURE to protect America’s energy security should alarm EVERY American.

His department is responsible for our nation’s NUCLEAR WEAPONS stockpile.

If he’s unable to handle the basic responsibilities of his job, he should step down.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Congrats! Keep fighting the good fight!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
IT’S NATIONAL VOTER REGISTRATION DAY.

Your voice matters. Your vote matters. Make sure you’re registered, make a plan, and SHOW UP this November.

Register at IWillVote.com.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Great work, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
SCOTUS has REJECTED Trump’s plan to change mail-in voting and rig the elections before the midterms.

Mail-in voting is safe and accessible. In California, ballots are sent to all registered voters the first week of October.

Let’s show up this November and take Congress back!

author: GavinNewsom
text: A little louder for the people in the back: The Trump Administration is the most corrupt administration in the history of the United States.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
September 11 forever changed our country — and the world.

25 years later, we remember the lives taken from us, honor the heroes who ran toward danger, and stand with every family forever changed by this day of horror.

We will never forget.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump just replaced the Pledge of Allegiance with a pledge of allegiance to himself.

This November, the choice is yours on the ballot: 

America or Trump.

author: GavinNewsom
text: You can resign any day, sir!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is personally profiting from a system he has every incentive NOT to regulate.

That’s a five-alarm fire.

While Washington looks the other way, California will keep leading with real rules, real accountability and real protections for consumers.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
BREAKING: I just signed the strongest kid safety laws for AI chatbots and social media in America.

California is banning addictive social media features for kids, cracking down on dangerous AI chatbots, and strengthening privacy protections for ALL kids.

PROTECT OUR KIDS!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
$11 insulin. Free school meals. Expanded child care. Child savings accounts.

California is lowering costs and putting money back in the pockets of working families.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Across this country, Democrats are fighting to lower costs, raise wages, and make it easier to get ahead.

The choice in front of voters couldn’t be more clear.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Trump taking L’s everywhere.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Putin must be so proud.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
After making you sicker and poorer with his war, Donald Trump now wants to buy your vote with $5,000 in taxpayer-funded blood money.

The most corrupt man ever to occupy the Oval Office.

author: GavinNewsom
text: HAPPY 176TH BIRTHDAY TO THE GREAT STATE OF CALIFORNIA!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
I formally invite Donald Trump to campaign in California ahead of the midterms. 

Sir, you are VERY popular!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
What is happening in this country is an outrage — and every person enabling it is complicit.

They’re standing by while our nation is sold out from under us. We WILL hold them to account.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Donald Trump has turned the presidency into the great grift in American history, and YOU are paying for it.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is doing everything he can to rig our elections and silence voters.

California will do EVERYTHING in our power to protect free and fair elections and your fundamental right to vote.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
People are showing up. Democrats are winning races across the country. Something BIG is building for November.

Keep showing up. Keep organizing. VOTE.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Congrats!! Let’s go!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
You can’t build a coalition by writing off entire states and only showing up when there’s a presidential election.

You build it by showing up — in school board races, state legislatures and communities everywhere.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
From California to the South, people are fed up.

Groceries and gas are up. Wages aren’t keeping pace. Families are getting squeezed.

This November, we have the power to change it.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Democracy won today. Keep fighting.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is trying to rig our elections and we have to stop him.

Show up and VOTE this November.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
North Carolina SHOWED UP over Labor Day weekend.

Candidates up and down the ballot are stepping up, people are organizing and voters are ready to turn out in RECORD numbers this November.

That’s how we win. That’s how we TAKE IT BACK.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
There’s a movement building in the South. 

People are PISSED at what Donald Trump’s one-party rule has done to our country. 

We are going to take our country back.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Gas rationing has arrived in Trump's America. 

Great work, Chairman Donald!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Labor Day is a reminder of a simple truth: WORKERS built this country.

But today, too many Americans are working harder, paying more and falling further behind — while Donald Trump gets richer and hands more wealth to the people at the very top.

Working people built America. This November, it’s time to take our country back.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Generations of Americans organized, marched, and sacrificed to secure the right to vote.

This November, we carry that fight forward.

They fought for those seats. Now it’s our turn to WIN them.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Shut up.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump wants you distracted, exhausted and demoralized.

But across this country, people are waking up.

Democrats are united, and we’re fighting back.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Americans are fed up — and they’re SHOWING UP.

Democrats have flipped over 30 state legislative seats from red to blue. Republicans have flipped ZERO.

Democrats are WINNING.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump promised to make us healthier and wealthier.

Instead, Americans are sicker and poorer, while he gets richer.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
This is sickening. 

There is no place — none — for political violence in our country. 

Grateful @amyactonoh is safe.

author: GavinNewsom
text: The energy in South Carolina is undeniable! Hope is here. Let’s turn it into victory this November.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California sued to protect mail-in voting and we WON.

We won't stop fighting for our democracy.

VOTE THIS NOVEMBER.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is lighting democracy on fire. 

We will NOT let him wreck our country. 

Show up and VOTE this November.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
We’re winning and Donald Trump knows it. 

His presidency will soon be over. 

Let’s finish the job.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
This one is REALLY going to trigger Fox News:

When only a handful of Americans control most of the nation’s wealth, the system is broken.

We need to democratize our economy if we’re going to save our democracy.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Trump’s supporters lost $3.8 billion on his meme coin. 

He raked in $600 million. 

Enough said.

author: GavinNewsom
text: This November it’s ALL on the line. VOTE.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Great work, @realDonaldTrump!

author: GavinNewsom
text: Thanks for spending the day with me!

author: GavinNewsom
text: FAFO!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Thank you for coming out! 

This was in rural South Carolina. 

DONALD TRUMP HAS NO IDEA WHAT’S COMING IN NOVEMBER – PEOPLE ARE PISSED!

author: GavinNewsom
text: Thank you for the warm welcome!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Honored to be in South Carolina with incredible candidates stepping up to serve, dedicated volunteers putting in the work, and voters determined to make their voices heard.

We all know what’s at stake this November. Now it’s time to show up and VOTE!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Grateful to spend time in Alabama today — and to walk through Montgomery, a city that has shaped the American story like few others.

These streets carry the legacy of generations who stood up to injustice, marched for freedom, and changed the course of our country.

Today, as forces once again try to rig the rules and silence Americans, we owe it to them to defend what they fought so hard to secure.

From California to Alabama, people want the same things: a fair shot, an affordable life, and a government that works for them. Now it’s on all of us to show up, organize, and vote.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Donald has a keyboard. Democrats have momentum.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Defying court orders to engage in election interference should bring prison time.

Lock them up.

Defend democracy.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Amen! Let’s make it happen.
